coaching.headline: A 39-minute grind we nearly threw, saved by finally winning the Orb Prime fight at 35.5.
coaching.team: Both mid and carry were read as theirs all game, and Murdock (49k physical) was a monster — they out-killed us on objectives 27 to 22. We lost a long string of fights to him: the 12.2 Fangtooth (1-4), the 20.3 Fangtooth (0-2), a 23.7 open-map bad trade (0-3), and the 27.4 Orb Prime fight (1-4). What saved it was refusing to keep flipping the same fight and instead grouping late — we out-damaged them on objectives overall (92k to 42k) and won the 35.5 Orb Prime fight (3-2) and the 38.1 close (3-0). The lesson is the 23.7 bad trade: we had the bodies (5v4) and still went 0-3 in the open — we took Primal Fangtooth in the same window, so read it as a trade, but a fight opened with the man up is one we should win outright.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Surviving a long run of losses to a 49k-damage Murdock and finally winning the 35.5 Orb Prime fight (3-2) plus the 38.1 close — after the 27.4 Orb Prime loss (1-4) nearly ended it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase died 6 times, mostly into Murdock in the lost fights (12.2, 27.4). As the frontline support facing a 49k carry, the peel had to be on our own carries, not on the front line of dives. The win came when the team stopped forcing those fights — the support's job is to call that earlier.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Best US game — Greystone 5/3/11, 40k hero damage, 46k mitigated, and Goldilocks324 won the 13.6 Fangtooth pick (2-0). Greystone was the steady frontline that let the late grouping work. The 35.5 Orb Prime win that saved it ran through Goldilocks324. Keep being the anchor that doesn't over-commit.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow was the unfavored carry into Murdock (theirs all game) and Cuban Noobster still went 8/4/3 with 21151 into objectives. 4 deaths is clean for an unfavored lane. Cuban Noobster was in the 23.7 bad trade though — with the lane behind, sit back and let the frontline absorb Murdock before committing.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Lt. Belica top-damaged the team (45202) but died 8 times. Willy was in the 12.2 and 27.4 losses to Murdock. As a back-line setup mid, 8 deaths means positioning too aggressively into a fed physical carry. Land the stun from range and stay out of his reach.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera was the objective engine — 49926 damage to objectives is enormous and it's why we out-damaged them on majors despite the kill deficit. 7 deaths and 13571 hero damage say Xeebs was diving for camps more than fighting; in a game decided by team fights vs Murdock, balance the objective focus with being present for fights like the 35.5 win.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.8s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Muriel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Alacrity shield+AS → Consecrated Ground bubble → Reversal global save
enemyKits.winCondition: keep the carry alive with global shields and enable their damage

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch

enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 635 damage mitigated a minute, more than 90% of Murdock carry players this patch.
Long Arm of the Law at rank 3: 95s base, about 86.4s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Ruination 10.
Murdock dealt 48,566 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +357 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Phase (level 18: about 176 physical armor, 120 after penetration; took 13,016 physical damage from heroes, 68% of all hero damage they took) and Khaimera (level 18: about 98 physical armor, 62 after penetration; took 14,997 physical damage from heroes, 58% of all hero damage they took) that is about 25% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Ruination (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Apply a bleed that drains Mana by 30 (+8% Target's Max Mana) over 4s. Deals True Damage equal to 80% of the Mana Drained.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 1,805 healing recorded.

Lesson: Murdock's penetration cut through: Phase took about 25% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 176, about 120 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).

ability.name: Make Way
ability.what: Summon a fiery whirlwind that deals 90/145/200/255/310 (+90%)(+80%) physical damage over 4s.

loadout.plain: Make Way hits the nearest enemy harder. Stand on your target with the whirlwind to get the most from it.

loadout.name: Iceskorn Talons
loadout.text: Glacial Colosseum:  Create an Ice Sheet around you for 8s. Allies on the sheet gain 12% Physical Power for 3s. They also gain 12% Movement Speed for 3s. Enemy Units on the sheet are Slowed by 10%.
loadout.plain: Drops an ice sheet that slows enemies and speeds up and powers up allies. Drop it after Assault The Gates so enemies stay slowed inside your Make Way whirlwind.
